notes.title: Crisis on the Planet of the Apes 1.1 Patch released! New controls + more!
notes.content:
Hola Apes Fans!,

We’re proud to rollout Crisis on the Planet of the Apes version 1.01 to all users! This patch includes a number of new features designed to respond to the feedback we’ve had since launch, especially around improving the reliability of tracking and the comfort of controls. 

[list]
    [*]Changed the control scheme so that players no longer need to hold grip in order to keep the gun in their hands
    [*]Changed the control scheme so that players can fire with the trigger
    [*]Added a new Player Positioning System that’ll help reduce instances of players getting stuck 
   [*]Fixed a number of issues with players getting stuck inside geometry, especially in Warehouse and Slaughterhouse.
   [*]Fixed a number of small visual and animation issues
   [*]Retuned the game for faster paced combat encounters
[/list]

As always, if you have issues please contact us at foxnextvrsupport@fox.com or make a post on the forums. We’re always looking for ways to improve the game and your feedback is invaluable!

Apes Together Strong!,
The FoxNext VR Studio Team

notes.title: New patch coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello Steam Community,

After watching your streams and reading your reviews and forum posts, we wanted you to know that we hear you and are working on a PC patch to help improve the game for both Rift and Vive.

Here’s a sneak peak at some of the improvements we are working on:
[list]
[*] Supporting alternate control scheme : d-pad to grip and trigger to fire
[*] Fixed bugs with players getting stuck in the world
[*] Fixing variety of animation and audio bugs
[*] Fixed bug with menu reliability and visibility
[*] Improved tutorial messaging
[*] Improved lost tracking messaging
[*] Fixed bug that made boss battle too easy
[/list]
In addition, we are looking into what it would take to support WMR and Samsung Odyssey.

Keep sending us feedback, we’ll see you in the forums.

Apes together strong!

FoxNext VR Studio Team

PS - Did you know this game tells a unique story set in the POTA universe? Find out more about this and other insider game details on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/246600342 ]VR Power Hour, All Devved Up![/url]
